Class HdrGainMapDeriver

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.ultrahdr.HdrGainMapDeriver
public final class HdrGainMapDeriver extends Object
Derives an ISO 21496-1 gain map from a true-HDR frame (e.g. JXL PQ/HLG) that carries no gain map of its own.

This keeps gain maps transparent: no source needs to know about them — when the UltraHdrTileSink receives an HdrFrame without a gain map, it derives one here before WASM assembly instead of failing.

The forward convention mirrors ultrahdr-core's compute_gainmap (vendored reference, ultrahdr-core 0.4.1): per-channel gain (hdr + altOff) / (sdr + baseOff) with 1/64 offsets, clamp to [1.0, maxBoost], normalize in log domain, gamma 1.0, 8-bit encode. Deviations are deliberate and documented: the ceiling is adaptive (max(6.0, tilePeak) instead of the reference's fixed 6.0, so nothing ever clips), the gain map is always multi-channel RGB, and sampling is a box average in linear light rather than center-sampling.

Scale handling: HDR values are absolute while the SDR base is relative, so HDR linear light is normalized by the diffuse-white anchor (100 nits for PQ; HLG reference white for HLG; 1.0 for linear/sRGB) before the ratio. The SDR base is always the pipeline's delegate-rendered tile — the same bytes the WASM encoder muxes — so reconstruction matches by construction. No gamut conversion is performed (per-channel gains in the frame's native primaries).

  • Method Details

    • derive

      public static HdrGainMapDeriver.Derivation derive(HdrFrame frame, int x, int y, int w, int h, BufferedImage sdrTile)
      Derives the gain map for one tile.
      Parameters:
      frame - Full-image HDR frame (must not carry usable gain data — callers branch on HdrFrame.hasGainMap() first).
      x - Tile region X in frame pixels (HDR-space coords: apply any primary/gainmap ratio mapping before calling).
      y - Tile region Y in frame pixels.
      w - Tile region width in frame pixels.
      h - Tile region height in frame pixels.
      sdrTile - Pipeline SDR rendition of the same region (the exact image the delegate sink renders: sizes may differ from w,h at scaled levels).
      Returns:
      Gain map at ceil(tile/scale) resolution plus metadata.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for UNKNOWN transfer functions (no defined EOTF to linearize with).
